:::{#exr-sum-deviations-zero}
#### Deviations from the mean sum to zero

Show that $\sumin (x_i - \bar{x}) = 0$.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-sum-deviations-zero}

$$
\begin{aligned}
\sumin (x_i - \bar{x})
&= \sumin x_i - \sumin \bar{x}
&& \text{(split the sum)}\\
&= \sumin x_i - n \bar{x}
&& \text{(sum of a constant)}\\
&= n \bar{x} - n \bar{x}
&& \text{($\sumin x_i = n \bar{x}$)}\\
&= 0
&& \text{(subtract)}
\end{aligned}
$$

The same steps with $y_i$ in place of $x_i$
show that $\sumin (y_i - \bar{y}) = 0$.

:::
